info.name: Esports Tournaments API
info.description: Every endpoint, in the order the app is used: teams and players, a tournament, registration, a match and its result, standings, errors, then cleanup. Run the whole collection in order; later requests use ids saved by earlier ones. Change baseUrl if the API is not on port 8000.

request.description: A random number keeps names unique, so the collection can run many times.

exec: pm.test("All fields replaced", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().real_name === "Postman Player Jr").to.be.true);
pm.test("Has the new player", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(p => p.id === pm.collectionVariables.get("playerId"))).to.be.true);
pm.test("Scheduled, no winner", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status === "scheduled" && pm.response.json().winner === null).to.be.true);
